data.narrative:
Lodge Systems is a pre-seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The available comp universe consists of 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The broader Defense & Security sector contains 22 firms, though application of narrow stage and tier filters yields insufficient data density for reliable peer-median benchmarking.

Standard peer-median valuation is not applicable in this case. A search across the 22 same-sector companies identified zero companies at the same pre-seed stage, only one at an adjacent stage, and zero in a similar valuation tier. This filtering yields fewer than the three datapoints required for robust comparative analysis. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material selection bias and misrepresent valuation multiples across heterogeneous business scales and risk profiles.

Given these constraints, valuation analysis of Lodge Systems cannot be triangulated through peer multiples alone. Recommended next steps would involve obtaining primary financial data (revenue, growth, burn rate) from Lodge Systems to enable cost-of-capital or discounted cash flow approaches, or identifying additional pre-seed or early-stage Defense & Security companies to establish a minimum viable comp set. The current peer universe is too sparse at the target's stage to support a quantitative valuation range.
